column1: # Label cleaning, layer 1: dialect and reduced spellings of common words (cleaning plan "Layer 1", "Dialect
# spellings"; training/cleaning.py). "dialect<TAB>standard[<TAB>lower]": the dialect form becomes its standard
# spelling. Matched case-insensitively on whole tokens (an edge apostrophe is part of the form), except "lower"
# forms, which match only as written in lowercase. A capital first letter is kept ("Gonna" -> "Going to");
# capitals in the standard spelling ("I'm") are written as listed.

# Disabled by the net-harm check (cleaning plan Check 3, on the human-reference labels): 'cause, 'em, bein', comin', doin', dunno, gettin', goin', havin', kinda, lookin', mornin', nothin', seein', somethin', sorta
# g-dropped words: an allowlist of the forms found in the labels (written in lowercase at least four times,
# with the -ing form attested in the labels; lowercase only, so names such as "Dunkin'" are never touched)
